entry.title: 4.12.1 - Python scripts from AI assistants in Blender
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants connected to Blender with Connect MCP can now run a Python script when the built-in actions don't cover what they need, just like in Maya. They get the printed output and any error back, see which objects and meshes the script added or removed, can stop a long script, and in an open Blender each script is a single Ctrl+Z step.

entry.title: 4.12.0 - QuickExport 4.12
entry.content: • Improved (Blender, Maya): QuickExport moves to the 4.12 release line. This version has the same features and fixes as 4.11.597; update both Blender and Maya to 4.12.0 so they stay in step.

entry.title: 4.11.597 - Faster Maya Rigged exports
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Maya Rigged (Editable Rig) exports no longer load every image in the file each time. In scenes with many large textures, exporting a rig or a single object now takes about a second instead of several, and textures the export doesn't use stay unloaded.

entry.title: 4.11.596 - Display As carries over to Maya
entry.content: • New (Maya): Objects set to Display As Bounds or Wire in Blender (Object Properties > Viewport Display) now show the same way in Maya: as a bounding box or as wireframe. Maya only draws box bounds, so Sphere, Cylinder, Cone and Capsule bounds become a box, with a note in the import warnings.

entry.title: 4.11.595 - Bug reports from AI assistants
entry.content: • New (Blender): AI assistants connected to Blender through the QuickExport MCP server can now prepare a bug report the same way the Send Report button does, attach their renders, logs and transfer files, and show you exactly what is inside before anything is sent. Nothing is uploaded until it is explicitly submitted, and an interrupted upload picks up where it stopped.

entry.title: 4.11.594 - ZBrush side for every version
entry.content: • Improved (Blender): Install ZBrush Side now installs QuickExport into every ZBrush 2026+ on your machine, not just the newest. A version it can't install into (never opened yet, or 2026.0 without admin rights) is skipped with a note saying why, and the others still install.

entry.title: 4.11.593 - ZBrush install fix
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Install ZBrush Side works when more than one ZBrush version is installed: it picks the asset folder that belongs to the ZBrush it installs into

entry.title: 4.11.592 - Maya ZBrush parenting fix
entry.content: • Fixed (Maya): Meshes under a moved group or parent no longer shift when sent to ZBrush and back. Grouping a ZBrush import and moving the group keeps it in place too.

entry.title: 4.11.589 - Maya shelf and ZBrush
entry.content:
• Fixed (Maya): The shelf Import button picks up meshes sent from ZBrush when they are newer than the latest Blender transfer.
  • Fixed (Maya): The shelf Export button works in ZBrush mode and uses the ZBrush Export Scale.

entry.title: 4.11.588 - ZBrush parenting fix
entry.content: • Fixed (Blender): Objects parented to an offset empty no longer shift when sent to ZBrush and back. Moving the parent later keeps the export in place too.

entry.title: 4.11.587 - ZBrush round-trips
entry.content:
• Fixed (Blender): ZBrush 2026.1 and newer: Install ZBrush Side now puts the QuickExport menu where ZBrush finds it. Reinstall if the menu was missing.
  • Improved (Blender): Meshes coming back from ZBrush replace their match directly, so imports are faster. Your Tool is still backed up.
  • Fixed (Blender): Parented objects go to ZBrush and back in their parent's space, so hierarchies keep their transforms.
  • Fixed (Blender): ZBrush imports keep vertex groups, creases, seams, extra UV maps and UV map names, so modifiers keep working.
  • New (Blender): Keep UVMap option keeps Blender's UVs instead of the ones from ZBrush.

entry.title: 4.11.581 - Gamma, curves and IES fixes
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Gamma on non-negative colors builds a single node.
  • Fixed (Maya): RGB Curves cover the full range of colors that reach them.
  • Fixed (Maya): IES light profiles survive temp-folder cleanup on macOS and Linux.
  • Fixed (Maya): World Environment Textures keep their interpolation in Arnold.

entry.title: 4.11.569 - Steadier Maya imports
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Import checks warn instead of failing, and an object that fails is skipped while the rest finish.
  • Fixed (Maya): The import progress window stays above the main Maya window.
  • Improved (Maya): Extend, Clip and Mirror image extension carry over to Arnold.
  • Improved (Maya): Overwriting a scatter updates only its points when that's all that changed.
  • New (Maya): Rec.2020, Display P3 and ACES AP0 working spaces convert correctly.
  • Fixed (Maya): Point instancers hide their prototype curves so Arnold renders them.

entry.title: 4.11.560 - Color spaces in any OCIO config
entry.content:
• Improved (Blender, Maya): Every image texture carries its color space, matched by meaning even in renamed or custom OCIO configs.
  • Improved (Maya): QuickExport never writes a color space your Maya config lacks, and warns when Maya color management is off.
  • New (Maya): The import result lists any color spaces that were substituted.
  • Improved (Maya): World HDRIs use the same color space matching.
  • Fixed (Maya): Image Texture interpolation, including Closest, carries over to Arnold.

entry.title: 4.11.548 - Shader accuracy pass
entry.content:
• Fixed (Maya): Legacy Hue/Saturation shifts hue by the right amount.
  • Improved (Maya): Displacement Midlevel maps to Arnold's displacement zero value.
  • Improved (Maya): Wave, Gradient (Easing, Spherical, Quadratic, Diagonal) and legacy Invert build fewer nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): Mapping with linked Rotation, Location or Scale converts to a single matrix.
  • Improved (Maya): World color correction folds into the image node.

entry.title: 4.11.543 - Imports that don't get stuck
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Objects with the same name never block an import; ones that can't be matched import alongside.
  • Improved (Maya): Re-importing a package replaces the real previous import, not your duplicates of it.
  • Improved (Maya): Children you added in Maya are relocked after they are carried over.
  • Improved (Blender, Maya): Objects with no geometry and no children are no longer transferred.
  • Improved (Maya): The QuickExport menu in Maya's top bar is gone; installing removes a leftover one.
  • Fixed (Maya): Maya runs with a separate profile keep your OCIO config.
  • Fixed (Blender): The App Integrations header ignores apps that aren't installed.

entry.title: 4.11.531 - Smarter re-imports
entry.content:
• Improved (Blender, Maya): Imported objects are selected after every import.
  • Improved (Maya): Re-importing a World replaces it, keeps your work on it, and names it after the Blender World.
  • Improved (Maya): Imports override artist locks and skip only referenced nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): Repeat imports replace their previous import, including instanced targets; other instances keep a copy.
  • Fixed (Maya): Re-exporting a selected armature replaces its rig without deleting objects that weren't exported.
  • Improved (Maya): Volume-only materials no longer get a placeholder surface shader.
  • Improved (Maya): Imports skip the confirm dialog when nothing would be replaced, and show progress in the main help line.

entry.title: 4.11.523 - Quicker overwrite dialogs
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): The world overwrite dialog opens straight away, and import popups plan the scene only once.
  • New (Maya): The world overwrite dialog gets Select and Add World.
  • Improved (Maya): Overwrites keep children you added in Maya, and you can roll back from the dialog.
  • Improved (Maya): A grayscale image plugged into a number input uses Alpha Is Luminance in any color space.

entry.title: 4.11.520 - No custom Arnold plug-in
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Converted scenes need only standard MtoA; QuickExport no longer ships its own Arnold plug-in.
  • Improved (Maya): Normal Map, Bump, Displacement and Voronoi use standard Arnold nodes, and Bump strength now matches Cycles.
  • Improved (Maya): Lights convert to standard Maya and Arnold lights.
  • Improved (Maya): The QE_World viewport scale defaults to 100.
  • Fixed (Maya): Meshes with no faces are no longer imported into Maya.

entry.title: 4.11.516 - Standard Arnold nodes everywhere
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Math, Vector Math, Mix, Noise, Checker, Radial Gradient, Fresnel, Layer Weight, HSV/HSL and Is Camera Ray all convert to standard Maya and Arnold nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): Baked volume density uses standard Arnold nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): The Maya overwrite dialog opens faster.
  • Improved (Blender): Export Temporary Copies refreshes the scene 6 times instead of 14.
